description: This file contains utility functions for stateless operations in PyTorch, including handling tied weights, reparameterization, and a deprecated functional call API for modules.

classes.name: NamedMemberAccessor
classes.description: A utility class for accessing and swapping module parameters and buffers.

methods.name: _untie_named_tensors_map
methods.description: Creates a new dictionary with tied tensors in a module untied based on user-provided parameters.

methods.name: _reparametrize_module
methods.description: Context manager to reparameterize a module, optionally tying or untieing weights.

methods.name: functional_call
methods.description: Deprecated function to perform a functional call on a module with specified parameters and buffers.

methods.name: _functional_call
methods.description: Internal function implementing the core logic for the functional call, handling JIT and DataParallel restrictions.
